definition: SameCluster F w v is F.access w v ∧ F.access v w. On S4 frames this is the standard mutual-accessibility equivalence relation. Without reflexivity the set of worlds mutually accessible from w can be empty. A terminal cluster in this experiment has no outgoing edge to a world outside the cluster; terminality alone does not imply modal collapse or singleton cardinality.
